children: is setting a more ambitious long-term growth target, forecasting more than $63 billion in annual revenue by fiscal 2030 as artificial intelligence becomes increasingly central to its enterprise software strategy. The outlook comes in above Wall Street expectations and gives investors a clearer benchmark for judging whether Salesforce can turn its growing AI portfolio into durable top-line acceleration.
Chief Operating and Financial Officer Robin Washington outlined the target at the company's annual conference Wednesday.
The projection covers the fiscal year ending January 2030 and exceeds the roughly $61.4 billion analyst consensus compiled by Bloomberg.

The forecast is particularly important because Salesforce spent much of the recent AI boom facing a different investor concern: that generative AI tools could weaken traditional enterprise software platforms by automating tasks that previously required dedicated applications.
Management is now arguing the opposite case.
Salesforce is positioning its data, customer relationships and workflow software as infrastructure for enterprises deploying autonomous AI agents.

New products are central to that effort. The company highlighted Claudeforce, which connects Salesforce data with Anthropic's Claude, while Koa, an AI reasoning model built on Nvidia architecture, is currently being tested by nearly 1,000 enterprise customers.

Slack is also becoming more strategically important. Salesforce says the collaboration platform is evolving into a primary control hub where companies can manage autonomous AI agents alongside employees.

The company has benefited financially from AI outside its operating business as well. An early Anthropic investment generated a $2.6 billion gain last quarter, with Salesforce eventually planning to monetize those shares to help fund its $60 billion stock repurchase program.
The $63 billion target raises the bar for execution.
Investors now need evidence that AI products can accelerate organic revenue growth rather than simply protect Salesforce's existing customer base from disruption.
Claudeforce, Koa and Slack give Salesforce multiple paths to monetize enterprise AI, but adoption and customer spending will matter more than product announcements.

If AI expands wallet share across existing customers while attracting new workloads, Salesforce could emerge as a major enterprise AI platform. If growth remains dependent on traditional CRM spending, the new 2030 target could become increasingly difficult to justify.

title: Salesforce Just Gave Investors a $63 Billion Reason
